title: S&P DJI December quarterly rebalance takes effect at the open — S&P 500/100/400/600 membership and float changes, implemented at the 2026-12-18 close
source: EST: date derived by applying the owner's own published convention to the 2026 calendar, and by direct analogy to the September 2026 instance this calendar already carries with an owner-sourced press release. sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21 is dated to the Monday open after the third-Friday close (S&P DJI's changes 'effective prior to the open' on 2026-09-21, implemented at the 2026-09-18 close) on a press.spglobal.com release fetched direct 2026-09-08. December 2026's third Friday is 2026-12-18 (Fridays: 12-04 / 12-11 / 12-18 / 12-25, weekday arithmetic computed mechanically by this proposer) and the following Monday is 2026-12-21 — Christmas Day 2026-12-25 is a Friday and does not fall between them, so no holiday moves either date. The 2026-12-18 close is independently confirmed as opex-2026-12-18 on the OCC calendar. Corroborating the implementation leg from a primary this proposer read in full: SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes) — 'Changes will become effective after the market close on the third Friday of March, June, September and December.' Filed estimate because the DECEMBER release naming these constituents does not exist yet: S&P DJI announces the quarterly membership changes after the close of the FIRST Friday, i.e. ~2026-12-04 (already tracked as proposals/sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04.from-sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21.json), so no owner-published December statement can be fetched today. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the sp-rebalance-reference-close-2026-12-11 initial research (2026-09-08). Found by enumerating December's Select Sector / S&P DJI milestone chain against September's, which is fully populated, rather than by reading a new source — THE GAP IS THE POINT. September 2026 carries the whole chain: add/drop pro-forma 09-04, capped pro-forma and reference close 09-11, and this effective-date entry 09-21. December 2026 carries the 12-04 add/drop file (proposed), the 12-11 reference close (this proposer's own event), the 12-18 witching close as opex-2026-12-18 — and NOTHING for the open at which the membership changes are actually in force. WHY IT IS WORTH A SEPARATE ENTRY RATHER THAN A FOOTNOTE ON opex-2026-12-18: the September ledger's own re-extraction found that ten of that quarter's moves were MIGRATIONS between S&P Composite 1500 tiers (TAP, TTD and BLDR each appear twice in the release, as S&P 500 deletions and SmallCap 600 additions), not expulsions — so the closing imbalance is a tier-to-tier handoff whose size the witching ledger neither computes nor claims to. TWO THINGS THE RESEARCHING LANE SHOULD ESTABLISH, because this proposal deliberately did not: (1) whether the ~2026-12-04 release, once published, dates the effective open to 2026-12-21 verbatim — that is what would let this entry promote off estimate on a NEWS: owner prefix, exactly as the September sibling did; (2) whether the December quarterly carries the same migration-heavy shape as September's, which is what decides whether the 12-18 closing imbalance is a net flow or a swap. Low impact and market-structure only: it changes execution timing, never direction, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4/G1) is index-flow-keyed. Kind sector matches sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21.
